mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate reduces the risk-free rate and lowers equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.0% signals labor market weakness that precedes corporate earnings deterioration, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicates broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue outlook.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 95.0 indicates improving manufacturing output, correlating with stronger corporate profits and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during post-recession recovery when INDPRO exceeds 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate reduces discount rates for equity valuation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Employment levels below 132,000 thousand persons indicate weak labor market conditions that precede corporate earnings weakness, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS is below 132,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in quarterly GDP (GDPC1) and residential construction (HOUST) signals broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue outlook.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST decline, or interaction term Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In manufacturing recovery, industrial production (INDPRO) exceeding 95.0 for two consecutive months indicates improving supply chain conditions, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances during manufacturing recovery when INDPRO exceeds 95.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 2-year rolling window.
